note: COMPENSATION & CLAIMS register screens at SmartPRS 2 parity. Every key here SUPERSEDES the entry of the same key in modules.json (a drop-in wins). Columns beyond the ported tables come from database/migrations/2026_03_02_000200_compensation_columns.php. Amounts are decimal strings; statuses are the vocabularies surface/Recoveries.php and surface/screens/claims.php read.

modules.label: Expense Claims
modules.description: Petrol, travel, court fees — claimed with the amount and what it was for. Approve or reject on Claim Approvals; approved claims are earnings.

remarks.label: Note
remarks.help: What it was for — the approver reads this

status.label: Status
status.help: New claims are pending; Claim Approvals moves them on and records who decided

modules.label: Salary Advance
modules.description: Part of salary before payday. On approval it is paid and recovered on the payslip as its own line — per month, until the balance is gone.

per_month.label: Recover per month (₹)
per_month.help: Blank = nothing is recovered and the payslip says so. Equal to the amount = recovered in one month

balance.label: Opening balance (₹)
balance.help: What was still owed when this build took over; blank = the amount. Payroll never edits this — recovery is read from the closed runs

status.label: Status
status.help: disbursed / recovering = the payslip recovers it; approved = not yet money owed

modules.label: Loans
modules.description: Staff loans with EMI recovery: amount, EMI, months and the month EMIs start. Each closed payroll deducts one EMI as its own line; the last one is the remainder. See the schedule on Loan EMI Schedule.

tenure.label: Tenure (months)
tenure.help: What was sanctioned; the schedule counts instalments from the money, so the two can disagree and the money wins

start_month.label: EMIs start (YYYY-MM)
start_month.help: First payroll month that deducts an EMI, e.g. 2026-04

outstanding.label: Opening outstanding (₹)
outstanding.help: What was still owed when this build took over; blank = the loan amount. Payroll never edits this

installments_paid.label: Instalments already taken
installments_paid.help: Before this build recovered anything — only makes 'instalment 6 of 12' say 6; never money

status.label: Status
status.help: disbursed / recovering = the payslip recovers it

modules.label: Commission Entries
modules.description: Every commission claim: pick the scheme and enter the Target Achieved — the commission, TDS and net payable are worked out by the scheme, and its purpose, portfolio, TDS and payout (with salary or on its own date) come from Commission / Incentive Setup. A collection claim also carries its customer evidence.

employee_id.label: Employee
employee_id.help: A Company or Branch chosen = every active employee of Salary Type Commission there (one entry each). Leave Company and Branch as ALL to pick one employee.

claim_type.label: Claim Type
claim_type.help: Collection = one customer's collection; Simple = target / bonus / special incentive

scheme_id.label: Scheme
scheme_id.help: Purpose, portfolio, TDS and when it is paid all come from the scheme. Fixed Commission schemes are not listed — they pay by themselves every month

month.label: Payroll Month
month.help: The payslip month this is paid in

portfolio.label: Portfolio / Bank
portfolio.help: Spell it consistently — it is the key of the Bank Payout Pack

claim_type: Collection claim — money collected from a customer

account_ref.label: Account No / CC No / Customer ID

claim_type: Collection claim — money collected from a customer
Collection claim — money collected from a customer
Collection claim — money collected from a customer

base_amount.label: Target Achieved (₹)
base_amount.help: What the employee accomplished — the commission, TDS and net payable are worked out from it by the scheme

gross_amount.label: Commission — Gross (₹)
gross_amount.help: Worked out by the scheme from the Target Achieved — not typed

tds_rate.label: TDS % (194H)
tds_rate.help: Worked out from the Scheme's TDS (Commission / Incentive Setup). No scheme: Salary Type Commission = the flat %; Salary / Salary + Commission = 0 here, taxed on the income-tax slabs in payroll

modules.label: Commission & Incentive Schemes
modules.description: Publish offers your people claim against. Step by step: what it is paid on (amount collected, target achievement, or a fixed amount typed per claim), how it pays (% of the amount, a flat ₹ per claim, or slab bands), who it is for, the payout, the validity window and per-person caps.

name.label: Scheme Name
name.help: As you would announce it on the floor

status.label: Status
status.help: Only Active schemes are offered on Commission Entries

options.Manual: Fixed amount typed on each claim

target_amount.label: Target per person (₹)
target_amount.help: The target each person is measured against

min_collected.label: Minimum collection to be eligible (₹)
min_collected.help: Below this nothing is paid. Blank = no minimum

options.excess: Only the amount above the target / minimum

eligible_salary_types.label: Salary Type
eligible_salary_types.help: Blank = every Salary Type in the scope above

threshold.label: Pay only when achievement reaches (%)
threshold.help: e.g. 80 = paid only when collected is at least 80% of the person's target

slabs.label: Slab bands
slabs.help: One row per band: the % paid when the amount collected is up to that figure; the rate applies to the whole amount. Leave the last band's Up to blank = everything above.

tds_rate.label: TDS % (194H)
tds_rate.help: For employees of Salary Type Commission only; Salary / Salary + Commission are taxed on the income-tax slabs in payroll

payout_day.label: Payout day of the month
payout_day.help: e.g. 10 = paid on the 10th. 29–31 in a shorter month = its last day

payout_offset.label: Paid in

options.same: The same month as the claim

payout_offset.help: Each entry gets its own date: its payroll month (or the next) on the payout day. Blank = the month after

valid_till.label: Valid Till
valid_till.help: Blank = open. Entries are accepted only for payroll months inside Valid From – Till

max_claims.label: Max claims per person
max_claims.help: Blank = no limit. Counts the person's entries under this scheme (Rejected / Clawed back not counted)

max_amount.label: Max ₹ per person
max_amount.help: Blank = no limit. Total gross of the person's entries under this scheme

clawback.label: Clawback on bounce?
clawback.help: Ticked: a paid entry set to Clawed back raises a Clawbacks / Reversals row, recovered in payroll once approved. Not ticked: entries cannot be clawed back

modules.label: Commission Setup
modules.description: Commission schemes for employees whose Salary Type is Commission — who it is for (Company, Branch, Department, Team, Role, Designation, Employee; ALL = no restriction), commission type — Fixed (paid automatically every month, no entries), Target based flat % or Target based slab by % of target achieved (Target achieved entered on Commission Entries) — TDS, payout and validity.

name.label: Scheme Name
name.help: As you would announce it on the floor

status.label: Status
status.help: Only Active schemes are offered on Commission Entries

rate_type.label: Commission type

options.Percent: Target based — flat % of target achieved
options.Slab: Target based — slab by % of target achieved

rate_type.help: Fixed = the amount below is paid every month to everyone this scheme is for, with no entry (Commission Entries refuses them). Target based = HR enters the Target achieved on Commission Entries; flat = one %, slab = the % of the band the achievement % falls in

slabs.label: Slab bands
slabs.help: One row per band: when the achievement % (target achieved ÷ target × 100) is up to that figure, this % is paid on the target achieved. e.g. 80 → 0, 100 → 2, blank → 3 = nothing below 80%, 2% up to 100%, 3% above. Leave the last band's Up to blank = everything above. Add as many bands as needed.

options.excess: Only the amount achieved above the target / minimum

target_amount.label: Target per person (₹)
target_amount.help: The target each person is measured against — achievement % = target achieved ÷ this

threshold.label: Minimum achievement to be paid (%)
threshold.help: e.g. 85 = nothing is paid below 85% of the target. Blank = no minimum. The only minimum — slab bands can also pay 0 up to a level

min_collected.label: Minimum achieved to be eligible (₹)
min_collected.help: Below this nothing is paid. Blank = no minimum

eligible_salary_types.label: Salary Type
eligible_salary_types.help: The Salary Type this scheme pays, within the filters above. Blank = all

tds_applicable.label: TDS deduction applicable
tds_applicable.help: Tick to deduct TDS from each payout under this scheme

payout_method.label: Payout Method
payout_method.help: When it is paid: with that month's salary, or as a separate payout on the day set below (the same month or the month after)

payout_day.label: Payout day of the month
payout_day.help: e.g. 10 = paid on the 10th. 29–31 in a shorter month = its last day

payout_offset.label: Paid in

options.same: The same month as the claim

payout_offset.help: Each entry gets its own date: its payroll month (or the next) on the payout day. Blank = the month after

valid_till.label: Valid Till
valid_till.help: Blank = open. Entries are accepted only for payroll months inside Valid From – Till

max_claims.label: Max claims per person
max_claims.help: Blank = no limit. Counts the person's entries under this scheme (Rejected / Clawed back not counted)

max_amount.label: Max ₹ per person
max_amount.help: Blank = no limit. Total gross of the person's entries under this scheme

clawback.label: Clawback on bounce?
clawback.help: Ticked: a paid entry set to Clawed back raises a Clawbacks / Reversals row, recovered in payroll once approved. Not ticked: entries cannot be clawed back

modules.label: Bonus & Encashment
modules.description: One-time payouts outside regular salary — statutory or festival bonus, leave encashment — recorded, approved and folded into payroll.

employee_id.label: Employee
employee_id.help: Leave at ALL to pay every employee in that month's payroll

type.label: Type
type.help: Pick one, or “+ Add new…” to name another. Every type is paid in that month's payroll and shown on the payslip (Leave Encashment as its own line, the rest as Bonus)

month.label: Pay in month
month.help: The payroll month it is paid in

basis.label: How is it worked out?

options.percent: A percentage of a salary component

basis.help: Only the boxes for your choice are shown

basis_component.label: Of which salary component
basis_component.help: Taken from each employee's own salary

basis_value.label: Value
basis_value.help: Percentage: e.g. 8.33 = 8.33% of the component. Days: e.g. 15 = 15 days' pay, one day = component ÷ 30

amount.label: Amount (₹)
amount.help: Paid as it is to each employee covered

status.label: Status
status.help: Only Approved is paid in payroll

decided_by.label: Decided By
decided_by.help: Filled automatically when Status is changed from Pending

decided_at.label: Decided At
decided_at.help: Filled automatically, in the company's time zone

modules.label: Increment / Appraisal
modules.description: Old CTC to new CTC with the percentage, an optional promotion and the effective date, routed for approval. Increment letters are on HR Letters.

pct.label: % Increase
pct.help: Worked out from Old and New CTC: (new − old) / old × 100
